title: Arator's Relics of Light
summary: Arator searches for Light relics while confronting family, faith, and the defense of Quel'Thalas during Midnight.
opening: The defense of the Sunwell needed more than a single battlefield. Arator's journey crossed older holy places while his own inheritance came into question.
reviewNote: The preview sets up the route; verify the released quest ending and placement relative to the Sunwell campaign. Editorial chapter research tasks retained here: Establish why Arator is sent to seek Light relics. Follow the different claims on the Light he encounters. Examine his time with Sunwalker Dezco and what he learns. Review the climax and its consequence for Quel'Thalas.

chapters.title: A charge from Alonsus
chapters.body: The defense of Quel’Thalas drew Arator toward relics of the Light. Older holy places stood along a road bound to his own inheritance.

chapters.title: Light's Hope and Scarlet Monastery
chapters.body: Faith took different forms among those Arator encountered. The Light’s meaning became a question carried beside the relics he sought.

chapters.title: At Hammerfall
chapters.body: Sunwalker Dezco’s counsel brought another tradition into Arator’s journey. What he learned there remains part of the story still to be recovered.

chapters.title: Beneath Blackrock's shadow
chapters.body: The search returned toward Quel’Thalas and its defense. Its final cost and consequence remain open within this unfinished account.
